# tebib_load_balancer (Resource)

A layer 4 (TCP) / layer 7 (HTTP) load balancer in a VPC. Add `tebib_load_balancer_target_group`, `tebib_load_balancer_listener` and `tebib_load_balancer_target` resources to it. A public load balancer has a public IPv4 address; an internal one only its VPC address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_load_balancer" "web" {
  name = "web"
}

resource "tebib_load_balancer_target_group" "web" {
  load_balancer_id = tebib_load_balancer.web.id
  name             = "web"
  port             = 80
  health_check = {
    protocol = "http"
    path     = "/healthz"
  }
}

resource "tebib_load_balancer_listener" "http" {
  load_balancer_id = tebib_load_balancer.web.id
  port             = 80
  target_group_id  = tebib_load_balancer_target_group.web.id
}

resource "tebib_load_balancer_target" "web" {
  for_each         = { for vm in tebib_vm.web : vm.name => vm.id }
  load_balancer_id = tebib_load_balancer.web.id
  target_group_id  = tebib_load_balancer_target_group.web.id
  vm_id            = each.value
}

output "address" {
  value = tebib_load_balancer.web.public_address
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique among the project's load balancers. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `public_ip_id` (String) Public only: an allocated, unassociated `tebib_public_ip` to use. Default: one is allocated and released with the load balancer. Changing it replaces the load balancer.
- `scheme` (String) `public` (default): a public IPv4 address; `internal`: the VPC address only. Changing it replaces the load balancer.
- `security_group_ids` (Set of String) Security groups (1-5) that filter traffic to the listeners. Default: the VPC's default security group. Changes in place.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet to place it in (`subnet-...`). Default: the default VPC's default subnet. Changing it replaces the load balancer.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Its address inside the VPC (from 100.68.0.0/16).
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Load balancer ID (`lb-...`).
- `nodes_desired` (Number) Load balancer nodes it should run.
- `nodes_ready` (Number) Load balancer nodes running and ready.
- `public_address` (String) Its public IPv4 address (public load balancers).
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state: `active` once ready (or `error`).
- `status_message` (String) What the platform last said about the resource.
- `trn` (String) TebibHost resource name (TRN), for IAM policies.
- `vpc_id` (String) The VPC it is in.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <load_balancer_id>, optionally with <project_id>/ in front.
terraform import tebib_load_balancer.web lb-abc123
```
